    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ============================================================
            // ۱. ذرات معلق – canvas
            // ============================================================
            const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            let W, H;
            let particles = [];
            const PARTICLE_COUNT = 80;

            const COLORS = [
                'rgba(0, 255, 136, ',
                'rgba(255, 34, 85, ',
                'rgba(240, 240, 255, ',
            ];

            class Particle {
                constructor() {
                    this.reset();
                }
                reset() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * W;
                    this.y = Math.random() * H;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2.0 + 0.5;
                    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
                    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
                    this.colorIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length);
                    this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    this.pulseSpeed = 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.012;
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    this.pulse += this.pulseSpeed;
                    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) { this.speedX *= -1;
                        this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W, this.x)); }
                    if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) { this.speedY *= -1;
                        this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H, this.y)); }
                    this.currentOpacity = this.opacity * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(this.pulse));
                }
                draw() {
                    const alpha = Math.max(0.03, Math.min(0.8, this.currentOpacity));
                    const color = COLORS[this.colorIdx] + alpha + ')';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = color;
                    ctx.shadowColor = color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
            }

            function initParticles() {
                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                    particles.push(new Particle());
                }
            }

            function resizeCanvas() {
                W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            }

            function drawParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d18');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#05050a');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

                particles.forEach(p => { p.update();
                    p.draw(); });

                for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                        const maxDist = 130;
                        if (dist < maxDist) {
                            const alpha = (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.12;
                            const color = COLORS[0] + alpha + ')';
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.4;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
            }

            function setupParticles() {
                resizeCanvas();
                initParticles();
                drawParticles();
            }

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resizeCanvas();
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x = Math.min(p.x, W);
                    p.y = Math.min(p.y, H);
                });
            });

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupParticles);
            } else {
                setupParticles();
            }

            // ============================================================
            // ۲. منطق محاسبه مالیات (ایران)
            // ============================================================
            function calculateTax() {
                const profit = parseFloat(document.getElementById('profit').value) || 0;
                const exemptIncome = parseFloat(document.getElementById('exemptIncome').value) || 0;
                const nonDeductible = parseFloat(document.getElementById('nonDeductible').value) || 0;
                const reserves = parseFloat(document.getElementById('reserves').value) || 0;
                const companyType = document.getElementById('companyType').value;
                const taxYear = document.getElementById('taxYear').value;

                // محاسبه سود مشمول مالیات
                const taxable = Math.max(0, profit - exemptIncome - reserves + nonDeductible);

                // نرخ مالیات (بر اساس نوع شرکت)
                let rate = 0.25; // نرخ پیش‌فرض 25%
                if (companyType === 'cooperative') {
                    rate = 0.15; // تعاونی‌ها 15%
                } else if (companyType === 'ngo') {
                    rate = 0.00; // سازمان‌های غیرانتفاعی معاف
                } else if (companyType === 'public') {
                    rate = 0.25; // شرکت‌های عمومی 25%
                }
                // شرکت خصوصی 25%

                const taxPayable = taxable * rate;
                const installment = taxPayable / 4;

                // نمایش نتایج
                const resultDiv = document.getElementById('taxResult');
                resultDiv.classList.add('visible');

                document.getElementById('rProfit').textContent = profit.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rExempt').textContent = '-' + exemptIncome.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rNonDeduct').textContent = '+' + nonDeductible.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rReserves').textContent = '-' + reserves.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rTaxable').textContent = taxable.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rRate').textContent = (rate * 100) + '%';
                document.getElementById('rTaxPayable').textContent = taxPayable.toLocaleString() + ' ریال';
                document.getElementById('rInstallment').textContent = installment.toLocaleString() + ' ریال (هر قسط)';
            }

            window.calculateTax = calculateTax;

            // محاسبه اولیه در بارگذاری
            setTimeout(calculateTax, 200);

            // ============================================================
            // ۳. چک‌لیست ارزش افزوده
            // ============================================================
            const vatItems = [
                'اظهارنامه ارزش افزوده فصلی (فصل اول) ارسال شده است',
                'اظهارنامه ارزش افزوده فصلی (فصل دوم) ارسال شده است',
                'اظهارنامه ارزش افزوده فصلی (فصل سوم) ارسال شده است',
                'اظهارنامه ارزش افزوده فصلی (فصل چهارم) ارسال شده است',
                'صورت‌های خرید و فروش با نرخ <span class="highlight">۹٪</span> تطبیق دارد',
                'دفاتر قانونی فروش با فاکتورها مطابقت دارد',
                'جرایم تأخیر محاسبه و ثبت شده است',
                'معافیت‌های ارزش افزوده (ماده ۱۲) اعمال شده است',
                'فاکتورهای خرید با <span class="highlight red">۹٪</span> تفکیک شده است',
                'پرداخت مالیات در موعد مقرر انجام شده است',
                'صورت‌های مالی تطبیق داده شده با ارزش افزوده',
                'تأییدیه سازمان امور مالیاتی دریافت شده است'
            ];

            const checklistContainer = document.getElementById('vatChecklist');
            if (checklistContainer) {
                checklistContainer.innerHTML = vatItems.map((item, index) => `
                    <div class="checklist-item" data-index="${index}" onclick="toggleVatItem(this)">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="vat_${index}" />
                        <span class="item-text">${item}</span>
                        <span class="status-icon">✓</span>
                    </div>
                `).join('');

                // به‌روزرسانی آمار
                updateVatStats();
            }

            window.toggleVatItem = function(el) {
                const checkbox = el.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
                checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
                el.classList.toggle('checked', checkbox.checked);
                updateVatStats();
            };

            // تابع چک کردن همه
            window.checkAllVat = function(checked) {
                const items = document.querySelectorAll('.checklist-item');
                items.forEach((el, idx) => {
                    const cb = el.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
                    cb.checked = checked;
                    el.classList.toggle('checked', checked);
                });
                updateVatStats();
            };

            function updateVatStats() {
                const total = document.querySelectorAll('.checklist-item').length;
                const done = document.querySelectorAll('.checklist-item.checked').length;
                document.getElementById('vatDoneCount').textContent = done;
                document.getElementById('vatTotalCount').textContent = total;

                const statusEl = document.getElementById('vatStatus');
                if (done === total && total > 0) {
                    statusEl.textContent = '✅ کامل (آماده ارسال)';
                    statusEl.style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';
                } else if (done > total * 0.6) {
                    statusEl.textContent = '🟡 پیشرفت مناسب';
                    statusEl.style.color = '#ffd700';
                } else if (done === 0) {
                    statusEl.textContent = '⏳ شروع نشده';
                    statusEl.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.3)';
                } else {
                    statusEl.textContent = '🔄 در حال تکمیل';
                    statusEl.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.5)';
                }
            }

            // ============================================================
            // ۴. کپی نمونه گزارش در فوتر
            // ============================================================
            const footer = document.querySelector('.footer .copyright');
            if (footer) {
                const copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
                copyBtn.textContent = '📋 کپی نمونه گزارش';
                copyBtn.style.cssText = `
                    display: inline-block;
                    margin-top: 0.4rem;
                    padding: 0.2rem 1rem;
                    border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,0.08);
                    border-radius: 30px;
                    color: rgba(240,240,255,0.2);
                    font-size: 0.6rem;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    transition: 0.3s;
                    background: rgba(0,255,136,0.01);
                `;
                copyBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    copyBtn.style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';
                    copyBtn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,255,136,0.2)';
                });
                copyBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    copyBtn.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.2)';
                    copyBtn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,255,136,0.08)';
                });
                copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const reportSample = `
        گزارش حسابرس مستقل
        ———————————————
        به مجمع عمومی صاحبان سهام
        شرکت نمونه

        ما صورت‌های مالی شرکت را حسابرسی کرده‌ایم.
        به نظر ما، صورت‌های مالی وضعیت مالی و نتایج عملکرد را
        به‌طور مطلوب و طبق استانداردهای حسابداری نشان می‌دهند.

        تاریخ: ۱۴۰۴/۰۲/۲۰
        حسابرس: امیرحسین
        `;
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(reportSample).then(() => {
                        const orig = copyBtn.textContent;
                        copyBtn.textContent = '✅ کپی شد!';
                        copyBtn.style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.textContent = orig;
                            copyBtn.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.2)';
                        }, 2200);
                    }).catch(() => {
                        alert('مشکل در کپی کردن متن');
                    });
                });
                footer.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
                footer.appendChild(copyBtn);
            }

            console.log('💰 تطبیق مالیات · قوانین ایران · بارگذاری کامل شد');
        })();
    </script>

</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>تراز آزمایشی | حسابداران</title>
    <style>
        /* ============================================================
                   RESET & BASE – همانند داشبورد
                   ============================================================ */
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Vazirmatn:wght@300;400;700;900&display=swap');

        :root {
            --neon-green: #00ff88;
            --neon-red: #ff2255;
            --neon-white: #f0f0ff;
            --dark-bg: #0a0a12;
            --card-bg: rgba(18, 18, 30, 0.88);
            --glass-border: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.12);
            --shadow-green: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
            --shadow-red: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.08);
            --radius: 18px;
            --font: 'Vazirmatn', Tahoma, sans-serif;
            --transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: var(--font);
            background: var(--dark-bg);
            color: var(--neon-white);
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 0 1rem 3rem 1rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   CANVAS – ذرات معلق (زنده)
                   ============================================================ */
        #particles-canvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   WRAPPER اصلی
                   ============================================================ */
        .main-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            max-width: 1280px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 1.2rem 0 0 0;
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   HEADER – لوگو + نویگیشن
                   ============================================================ */
        .header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
            padding: 0.9rem 1.8rem;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-green), inset 0 0 60px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.02);
            position: relative;
        }

        .header::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -1px;
            left: 20%;
            width: 60%;
            height: 1px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--neon-green), var(--neon-red), transparent);
            opacity: 0.3;
        }

        .logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            font-size: 1.7rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--neon-green);
            text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .logo span {
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        .logo .badge {
            background: var(--neon-red);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            padding: 0.15rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.3);
            margin-right: 0.2rem;
        }

        .nav-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.4rem 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .nav-links a {
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.6);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            transition: 0.3s;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }

        .nav-links a:hover {
            color: var(--neon-white);
            border-color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.03);
        }

        .nav-links a.active {
            color: var(--neon-green);
            border-color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.05);
        }

        .nav-links .sep {
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.1);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }

        .header-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.6rem;
        }

        .header-actions a {
            color: var(--neon-white);
            text-decoration: none;
            padding: 0.3rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.06);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .header-actions a:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-red);
            color: var(--neon-red);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.08);
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   HERO – معرفی تراز آزمایشی
                   ============================================================ */
        .hero {
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2.8rem 2rem 2.4rem 2rem;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-green), inset 0 0 80px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.01);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .hero::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -60%;
            left: -30%;
            width: 160%;
            height: 160%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 40%, rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.04), transparent 70%);
            animation: heroGlow 10s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        @keyframes heroGlow {
            0% {
                transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
                opacity: 0.5;
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate(8%, 10%) scale(1.15);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        .hero .content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: 2.4rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .hero h1 .green {
            color: var(--neon-green);
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
        }

        .hero h1 .red {
            color: var(--neon-red);
            text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.15);
        }

        .hero h1 .white {
            color: var(--neon-white);
        }

        .hero .subtitle {
            font-size: 1rem;
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.6);
            max-width: 700px;
            margin: 0.6rem auto 1rem auto;
            line-height: 1.8;
        }

        .hero .stats-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 2rem 3rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            padding-top: 1.2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }

        .hero .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .hero .stat-item .num {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--neon-green);
            display: block;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
        }

        .hero .stat-item .label {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.35);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            margin-top: 0.1rem;
        }

        .hero .stat-item .num.red {
            color: var(--neon-red);
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.1);
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   جدول تراز آزمایشی
                   ============================================================ */
        .table-container {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            padding: 1.8rem 1.5rem 2rem 1.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-green);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        .table-container .table-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }

        .table-container .table-header h2 {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .table-container .table-header h2 .green {
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .table-container .table-header .actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.6rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .table-container .table-header .actions button {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            color: var(--neon-white);
            padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-family: var(--font);
            transition: 0.3s;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }

        .table-container .table-header .actions button:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-green);
            color: var(--neon-green);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
        }

        .table-container .table-header .actions button.danger:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-red);
            color: var(--neon-red);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.08);
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        table th {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.04);
            border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
            padding: 0.8rem 0.5rem;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
        }

        table td {
            padding: 0.4rem 0.3rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            vertical-align: middle;
        }

        table td input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
            min-width: 60px;
        }

        table td input:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--neon-green);
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.05);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.02);
        }

        table td input[type="number"] {
            text-align: center;
        }

        table td .del-btn {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: var(--neon-red);
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.3s;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem;
            border-radius: 6px;
        }

        table td .del-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.08);
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        table td .row-num {
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.2);
            font-size: 0.75rem;
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   نتیجه تراز
                   ============================================================ */
        .result-box {
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .result-box .totals {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .result-box .totals .total-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .result-box .totals .total-item .label {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.3);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .result-box .totals .total-item .value {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--neon-white);
        }

        .result-box .totals .total-item .value.green {
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .result-box .totals .total-item .value.red {
            color: var(--neon-red);
        }

        .result-box .status-msg {
            padding: 0.3rem 1.2rem;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .result-box .status-msg.success {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .result-box .status-msg.danger {
            background: rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.06);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 34, 85, 0.15);
            color: var(--neon-red);
        }

        .result-box .status-msg.info {
            background: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.06);
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.4);
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   FOOTER
                   ============================================================ */
        .footer {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1.2rem;
            padding: 1.8rem 1rem 0.5rem 1rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        .footer .links {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 1.2rem 2rem;
        }

        .footer .links a {
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.25);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }

        .footer .links a:hover {
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .footer .copyright {
            color: rgba(240, 240, 255, 0.12);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .footer .copyright .green {
            color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   RESPONSIVE
                   ============================================================ */
        @media (max-width: 992px) {
            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 1.8rem;
            }
            .hero .stats-row {
                gap: 1.2rem;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            body {
                padding: 0 0.6rem 2rem 0.6rem;
            }
            .header {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
                text-align: center;
                padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
            }
            .nav-links {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .header-actions {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .hero {
                padding: 2rem 1.2rem;
            }
            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 1.4rem;
            }
            .hero .subtitle {
                font-size: 0.85rem;
            }
            .hero .stats-row {
                gap: 0.8rem 1.5rem;
            }
            .hero .stat-item .num {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
            }
            .table-container {
                padding: 1rem;
            }
            .table-container .table-header {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .table-container .table-header .actions {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .result-box {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .result-box .totals {
                justify-content: center;
            }
            .footer {
                flex-direction: column;
                text-align: center;
            }
            .footer .links {
                justify-content: center;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .hero h1 {
                font-size: 1.1rem;
            }
            table {
                font-size: 0.75rem;
            }
            table td input {
                font-size: 0.7rem;
                padding: 0.3rem;
            }
        }

        /* ============================================================
                   UTILS & ANIMATIONS

    SCRIPT – ذرات معلق + منطق تراز
    ============================================================ -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ============================================================
            // ۱. ذرات معلق – canvas
            // ============================================================
            const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

            let W, H;
            let particles = [];
            const PARTICLE_COUNT = 80;

            const COLORS = [
                'rgba(0, 255, 136, ',
                'rgba(255, 34, 85, ',
                'rgba(240, 240, 255, ',
            ];

            class Particle {
                constructor() {
                    this.reset();
                }
                reset() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * W;
                    this.y = Math.random() * H;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2.0 + 0.5;
                    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
                    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;
                    this.colorIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length);
                    this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    this.pulseSpeed = 0.006 + Math.random() * 0.012;
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    this.pulse += this.pulseSpeed;
                    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) { this.speedX *= -1;
                        this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W, this.x)); }
                    if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) { this.speedY *= -1;
                        this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H, this.y)); }
                    this.currentOpacity = this.opacity * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(this.pulse));
                }
                draw() {
                    const alpha = Math.max(0.03, Math.min(0.8, this.currentOpacity));
                    const color = COLORS[this.colorIdx] + alpha + ')';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = color;
                    ctx.shadowColor = color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
            }

            function initParticles() {
                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
                    particles.push(new Particle());
                }
            }

            function resizeCanvas() {
                W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
            }

            function drawParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#0d0d18');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#05050a');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

                particles.forEach(p => { p.update();
                    p.draw(); });

                for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                        const maxDist = 130;
                        if (dist < maxDist) {
                            const alpha = (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.12;
                            const color = COLORS[0] + alpha + ')';
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.4;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
            }

            function setupParticles() {
                resizeCanvas();
                initParticles();
                drawParticles();
            }

            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                resizeCanvas();
                particles.forEach(p => {
                    p.x = Math.min(p.x, W);
                    p.y = Math.min(p.y, H);
                });
            });

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupParticles);
            } else {
                setupParticles();
            }

            // ============================================================
            // ۲. منطق تراز آزمایشی
            // ============================================================
            const tbody = document.getElementById('tbBody');
            const totalDrEl = document.getElementById('totalDr');
            const totalCrEl = document.getElementById('totalCr');
            const diffValEl = document.getElementById('diffVal');
            const statusMsg = document.getElementById('statusMsg');

            // تابع افزودن ردیف
            function addRow() {
                const row = tbody.insertRow();
                const num = tbody.rows.length;
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td><span class="row-num">${num}</span></td>
                    <td><input type="text" placeholder="نام حساب" class="account-name" style="width:100%;"></td>
                    <td><input type="number" class="dr" value="0" style="width:100%;" oninput="checkBalance()"></td>
                    <td><input type="number" class="cr" value="0" style="width:100%;" oninput="checkBalance()"></td>
                    <td><button class="del-btn" onclick="deleteRow(this)">✕</button></td>
                `;
                // بعد از افزودن، بررسی تراز
                checkBalance();
            }

            // تابع حذف ردیف
            window.deleteRow = function(btn) {
                const row = btn.closest('tr');
                row.remove();
                // شماره‌گذاری مجدد
                const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
                rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
                    const numSpan = r.querySelector('.row-num');
                    if (numSpan) numSpan.textContent = idx + 1;
                });
                checkBalance();
            };

            // تابع پاک کردن همه
            window.clearAll = function() {
                if (tbody.rows.length === 0) return;
                if (!confirm('آیا از پاک کردن همه ردیف‌ها اطمینان دارید؟')) return;
                tbody.innerHTML = '';
                // ۳ ردیف پیش‌فرض اضافه می‌کنیم
                for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) addRow();
                checkBalance();
            };

            // تابع اصلی بررسی تراز
            window.checkBalance = function() {
                const drInputs = tbody.querySelectorAll('.dr');
                const crInputs = tbody.querySelectorAll('.cr');

                let totalDr = 0;
                let totalCr = 0;

                drInputs.forEach(inp => {
                    totalDr += parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
                });
                crInputs.forEach(inp => {
                    totalCr += parseFloat(inp.value) || 0;
                });

                const diff = Math.abs(totalDr - totalCr);

                // نمایش جمع‌ها
                totalDrEl.textContent = totalDr.toLocaleString();
                totalCrEl.textContent = totalCr.toLocaleString();
                diffValEl.textContent = diff.toLocaleString();

                // وضعیت
                const hasData = totalDr !== 0 || totalCr !== 0;
                if (!hasData) {
                    statusMsg.className = 'status-msg info';
                    statusMsg.textContent = '⏳ داده‌ای وارد نشده';
                } else if (diff === 0) {
                    statusMsg.className = 'status-msg success';
                    statusMsg.textContent = `✅ تراز است. جمع بدهکار = جمع بستانکار = ${totalDr.toLocaleString()}`;
                } else {
                    statusMsg.className = 'status-msg danger';
                    statusMsg.textContent = `❌ تراز نیست. اختلاف: ${diff.toLocaleString()}`;
                }
            };

            // مقداردهی اولیه: ۵ ردیف پیش‌فرض
            (function initRows() {
                for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                    addRow();
                }
                // تنظیم نام‌های پیش‌فرض برای نمونه
                const names = ['صندوق', 'بانک', 'حساب دریافتنی', 'موجودی کالا', 'دارایی ثابت'];
                const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr');
                rows.forEach((r, idx) => {
                    const nameInput = r.querySelector('.account-name');
                    if (nameInput && idx < names.length) {
                        nameInput.value = names[idx];
                    }
                });
                checkBalance();
            })();

            // اضافه کردن متدهای global برای استفاده در onclick
            window.addRow = addRow;

            // ============================================================
            // ۳. کپی نمونه گزارش در فوتر (اختیاری)
            // ============================================================
            const footer = document.querySelector('.footer .copyright');
            if (footer) {
                const copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
                copyBtn.textContent = '📋 کپی نمونه گزارش';
                copyBtn.style.cssText = `
                    display: inline-block;
                    margin-top: 0.4rem;
                    padding: 0.2rem 1rem;
                    border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,0.08);
                    border-radius: 30px;
                    color: rgba(240,240,255,0.2);
                    font-size: 0.6rem;
                    cursor: pointer;
                    transition: 0.3s;
                    background: rgba(0,255,136,0.01);
                `;
                copyBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    copyBtn.style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';
                    copyBtn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,255,136,0.2)';
                });
                copyBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    copyBtn.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.2)';
                    copyBtn.style.borderColor = 'rgba(0,255,136,0.08)';
                });
                copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const reportSample = `
        گزارش حسابرس مستقل
        ———————————————
        به مجمع عمومی صاحبان سهام
        شرکت نمونه

        ما صورت‌های مالی شرکت را حسابرسی کرده‌ایم.
        به نظر ما، صورت‌های مالی وضعیت مالی و نتایج عملکرد را
        به‌طور مطلوب و طبق استانداردهای حسابداری نشان می‌دهند.

        تاریخ: ۱۴۰۴/۰۲/۲۰
        حسابرس: امیرحسین
        `;
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(reportSample).then(() => {
                        const orig = copyBtn.textContent;
                        copyBtn.textContent = '✅ کپی شد!';
                        copyBtn.style.color = 'var(--neon-green)';
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            copyBtn.textContent = orig;
                            copyBtn.style.color = 'rgba(240,240,255,0.2)';
                        }, 2200);
                    }).catch(() => {
                        alert('مشکل در کپی کردن متن');
                    });
                });
                footer.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));
                footer.appendChild(copyBtn);
            }

            console.log('📊 تراز آزمایشی · بارگذاری کامل شد');
        })();
    </script>

        .lb-item .lb-name { flex: 1; padding-left: 4px; }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl { font-weight: 600; }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.green { color: var(--green); }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.red { color: var(--red); }
        .lb-item .lb-pnl.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .lb-item.lb-top1 { background: var(--gold-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .lb-item.lb-top2 { background: var(--purple-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .lb-item.lb-top3 { background: var(--cyan-bg); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

        /* ===== v10 NEW: Bot & Trade Timeline ===== */
        .timeline-container {
            max-height: 400px;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .timeline-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 4px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-time {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            min-width: 40px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-icon { font-size: 0.6rem; }
        .timeline-item .tl-desc { flex: 1; }
        .timeline-item .tl-desc .highlight { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl {
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 40px;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.green { color: var(--green); }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.red { color: var(--red); }
        .timeline-item .tl-pnl.gold { color: var(--gold); }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: ELON FEED
               ================================================================ */
        .elon-feed-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            margin: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .avatar {
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--gold);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .ename {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .ehandle {
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-status {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-status .dot {
            width: 5px;
            height: 5px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--green);
            animation: pulse-dot 1.2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
            50% { opacity: 0.2; }
        }
        .elon-feed-item {
            background: var(--bg-hover);
            padding: 6px 8px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-text {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-text .highlight { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag {
            padding: 1px 8px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
        }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.long { background: var(--green-bg); color: var(--green); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.short { background: var(--red-bg); color: var(--red); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.analysis { background: var(--cyan-bg); color: var(--cyan); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.meme { background: var(--gold-bg); color: var(--gold); }
        .elon-feed-item .feed-meta .feed-tag.news { background: var(--purple-bg); color: var(--purple); }
        .elon-feed-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 4px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            padding-top: 4px;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .elon-feed-actions button {
            background: transparent;
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .elon-feed-actions button:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: SKILLS
               ================================================================ */
        .skills-detail {
            padding: 8px;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 8px 12px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow);
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.7rem; }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-header .skill-level { font-size: 0.5rem; color: var(--gold); }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-desc {
            font-size: 0.55rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 2px 0;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-progress {
            height: 4px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 4px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .skills-detail .skill-card-lg .skill-progress .fill {
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--pink));
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ================================================================
               TAB: SETTINGS
               ================================================================ */
        .settings-container {
            padding: 8px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 6px 8px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .text-xs {
            font-size: 0.5rem;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 3px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex label {
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex input[type="checkbox"] { accent-color: var(--gold); }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button:hover {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
        }
        .settings-container .bg-card .flex button.active {
            border-color: var(--gold);
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               BOTTOM NAVIGATION
               ================================================================ */
        .bottom-nav {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-around;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 4px 4px env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 4px) 4px;
            z-index: 100;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1px;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.45rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item .nav-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.2; }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item.active {
            color: var(--gold);
            background: var(--gold-bg);
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item .badge {
            position: absolute;
            top: -4px;
            right: -4px;
            background: var(--red);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.3rem;
            padding: 0 4px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-item:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }

        /* ================================================================
               TOAST, DOPAMINE, CONFETTI
               ================================================================ */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            top: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-strong);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 8px 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            max-width: 92%;
            pointer-events: none;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .toast.success { border-color: var(--green); }
        .toast.error { border-color: var(--red); }
        .toast.gold { border-color: var(--gold); }
        .toast.cyan { border-color: var(--cyan); }
        .toast.purple { border-color: var(--purple); }
        .toast.pink { border-color: var(--pink); }

        .confetti-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 99999;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .confetti-overlay .confetti-piece {
            position: absolute;
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 2px;
            animation: confettiFall linear forwards;
        }
        @keyframes confettiFall {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(0deg) scale(1);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(720deg) scale(0.2);
            }
        }

        .dopamine-banner {
            position: fixed;
            top: -100px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 10px 24px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            box-shadow: 0 0 80px rgba(255,215,0,0.06);
            z-index: 99998;
            text-align: center;
            transition: top 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1);
            max-width: 92%;
        }
        .dopamine-banner.show {
            top: 20px;
        }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-icon { font-size: 1.8rem; display: block; }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 900; }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.green { color: var(--green); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.red { color: var(--red); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-title.pink { color: var(--pink); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-sub { font-size: 0.55rem; color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .dopamine-banner .dopamine-streak {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--gold-bg);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
            padding: 1px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--gold);
        }

        /* ================================================================
               RESPONSIVE v10 — Desktop Optimizations
               ================================================================ */
        @media (min-width: 768px) {
            .divine-header .title { font-size: 1.2rem; }
            .divine-header .stats { font-size: 0.7rem; gap: 16px; }
            .trade-header { height: 56px; padding: 0 12px; }
            .sell-box .price, .buy-box .price { font-size: 1.1rem; }
            .chart-tools-row { height: 38px; padding: 2px 16px; }
            .main-content { padding: 0 0 var(--nav-height) 0; }
            #tab-arena { padding: 12px; gap: 12px; }
            .trade-panel .btn-row button { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 8px 0; }
            .gods-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
            .position-box { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
            #chartCanvas { min-height: 450px; }
            .timeline-container { max-height: 600px; }
            .leaderboard-container .lb-card { padding: 12px 16px; }
            .elon-feed-container .feed-header .feed-profile .avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; font-size: 1.5rem; }
            .elon-feed-item .feed-text { font-size: 0.85rem; }
        }
        @media (min-width: 1024px) {
            .divine-header { padding: 8px 24px; }
            .trade-header { height: 64px; padding: 0 16px; }
            .sell-box .price, .buy-box .price { font-size: 1.3rem; }
            .chart-tools-row { height: 40px; padding: 2px 20px; }
            #tab-arena { padding: 16px; gap: 16px; }
            .trade-panel .btn-row button { font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 10px 0; }
            .position-box .pos-value { font-size: 0.9rem; }
            #chartCanvas { min-height: 550px; }
            .bottom-nav { padding: 6px 12px; }
            .bottom-nav .nav-item { font-size: 0.6rem; }
            .bottom-nav .nav-item .nav-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; }
        }

        /* ================================================================
               UTILITY CLASSES
               ================================================================ */
        .flex { display: flex; }
        .flex-col { flex-direction: column; }
        .gap-4 { gap: 4px; }
        .gap-8 { gap: 8px; }
        .items-center { align-items: center; }
        .justify-between { justify-content: space-between; }
        .wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .w-full { width: 100%; }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }
        .text-gold { color: var(--gold); }
        .text-green { color: var(--green); }
        .text-red { color: var(--red); }
        .text-dim { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .text-sm { font-size: 0.65rem; }
        .text-xs { font-size: 0.5rem; }
        .mt-4 { margin-top: 4px; }
        .mb-4 { margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .p-4 { padding: 4px; }
        .hidden { display: none !important; }
        .border-bottom { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
        .rounded { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
        .bg-card { background: var(--bg-card); }
        .p-2 { padding: 2px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app">
        <!-- ================================================================
        DIVINE HEADER v10
        ================================================================ -->
        <div class="divine-header">
            <div class="title">
                ⚡ GOD ARENA
                <span class="sub">Elon Edition v10</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stats">
                <span class="stat">💰 <span class="val gold" id="headerBalance">10,000</span></span>
                <span class="stat">⭐ <span class="val cyan" id="headerLevel">1</span></span>
                <span class="stat">🔥 <span class="val pink" id="headerStreak">0</span></span>
                <span class="elon-badge" onclick="generateElonTweet()">
                    <span class="tweet-icon">🐦</span> Elon v10
                </span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ================================================================
        TRADE HEADER
        ================================================================ -->
        <div class="trade-header">
            <div class="sell-box" onclick="quickTrade('sell')">
                <span class="label">SELL</span>
                <span class="price" id="mt5SellPrice">0.00</span>
            </div>
            <div class="volume-box">
                <button class="vol-btn" onclick="adjustVolume(-0.01)">◀</button>
                <span class="vol-val" id="mt5Volume">0.02</span>
                <button class="vol-btn" onclick="adjustVolume(0.01)">▶</button>
            </div>
            <div class="buy-box" onclick="quickTrade('buy')">
                <span class="label">BUY</span>
                <span class="price" id="mt5BuyPrice">0.00</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ================================================================
        TOOLBAR
        ================================================================ -->
        <div class="chart-tools-row">
            <div class="left-tools">
                <span class="symbol" id="symbolDisplay">XAUUSD <span class="sub">Gold vs USD</span></span>
                <span class="tf active" onclick="setTimeframe('15s')" data-tf="15s">15s</span>
                <span class="tf" onclick="setTimeframe('1m')" data-tf="1m">1m</span>
                <span class="tf" onclick="setTimeframe('5m')" data-tf="5m">5m</span>
                <span class="tf" onclick="setTimeframe('15m')" data-tf="15m">15m</span>
                <span class="tf" onclick="setTimeframe('1h')" data-tf="1h">1h</span>
            </div>
            <div class="right-tools">
                <span class="tool-icon" onclick="toggleFullscreen()" title="Fullscreen">⛶</span>
                <span class="tool-icon" onclick="toggleIndicators()" title="Indicators">📈</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ================================================================
        MAIN CONTENT
        ================================================================ -->
        <main class="main-content">

            <!-- ===== TAB: ARENA v10 ===== -->
            <div id="tab-arena" class="tab-content active">
                <div class="arena-grid">
                    <div class="info-card full">
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Balance:</span><span class="value gold" id="arenaBalance">0.00</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Equity:</span><span class="value green" id="arenaEquity">0.00</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Free Margin:</span><span class="value" id="arenaFreeMargin">0.00</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Level:</span><span class="value gold" id="arenaLevel">1</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">XP:</span><span class="value gold" id="arenaXP">0</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Rank:</span><span class="value cyan" id="arenaRank">Bronze</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Trades:</span><span class="value" id="arenaTrades">0</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Win Rate:</span><span class="value gold" id="arenaWinRate">0%</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">P&L:</span><span class="value green" id="arenaPnl">0.00</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">Streak:</span><span class="value pink" id="arenaStreak">0</span></div>
                        <div class="row"><span class="label">God Kills:</span><span class="value gold" id="arenaGodKills">0</span></div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="trade-panel">
                    <div class="pair-select">
                        <label>Pair:</label>
                        <select id="pairSelect" onchange="changePair(this.value)">
                            <option value="XAUUSD">XAUUSD</option>
                            <option value="EURUSD">EURUSD</option>
                            <option value="GBPUSD">GBPUSD</option>
                            <option value="BTCUSD">BTCUSD</option>
                            <option value="ETHUSD">ETHUSD</option>
                            <option value="SOLUSD">SOLUSD</option>
                            <option value="DOGEUSD">DOGEUSD</option>
                            <option value="AUDUSD">AUDUSD</option>
                            <option value="NZDUSD">NZDUSD</option>
                            <option value="USDCAD">USDCAD</option>
                            <option value="USDJPY">USDJPY</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div><label>Volume (Lots)</label><input type="number" id="tradeVolume" value="0.02" step="0.01" min="0.01" max="10.0" /></div>
                    <div><label>Stop Loss</label><input type="number" id="tradeSL" placeholder="0.00" step="0.01" /></div>
                    <div><label>Take Profit</label><input type="number" id="tradeTP" placeholder="0.00" step="0.01" /></div>

                    <!-- ===== v10 NEW: R1 R2 R3 Risk Manager ===== -->
                    <div class="risk-manager">
                        <div class="rm-row">
                            <label>Risk $:</label>
                            <input type="number" id="riskAmount" value="20" step="1" min="1" placeholder="Risk $" oninput="updateRiskFromDollar()" />
                            <label>Reward $:</label>
                            <input type="number" id="rewardAmount" value="40" step="1" min="1" placeholder="Reward $" oninput="updateRiskFromDollar()" />
                            <button onclick="applyRiskPreset(1)">R1</button>
                            <button onclick="applyRiskPreset(2)">R2</button>
                            <button onclick="applyRiskPreset(3)">R3</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="leverage-row">
                        <span>Leverage:</span>
                        <input type="range" id="leverageSlider" min="1" max="50" step="1" value="10" oninput="updateLeverage(this.value)" />
                        <span class="lev-val" id="leverageDisplay">10x</span>
                        <input type="number" id="leverageInput" value="10" min="1" max="50" step="1" onchange="updateLeverage(this.value)" />
                    </div>
                    <div class="btn-row">
                        <button class="btn-buy" onclick="openTrade('buy')" id="btnBuy">📈 BUY</button>
                        <button class="btn-sell" onclick="openTrade('sell')" id="btnSell">📉 SELL</button>
                        <button class="btn-close" onclick="confirmClose()">✕ Close</button>
                        <button class="btn-skill" onclick="toggleSkillPanel()">⚡ Skill</button>
                        <button class="btn-arena" onclick="startBattle()">⚔️ Battle</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Position Box -->
                <div class="position-box" id="positionBox">
                    <div class="pos-item"><div class="pos-label">Position</div><div class="pos-value" id="posDir">—</div></div>
