    <!-- ================================================================ -->
    <script>
        (function() {
            'use strict';

            // ===== STORAGE =====
            const STORAGE_CUSTOMERS = 'daftar_customers';
            const STORAGE_REMINDERS = 'daftar_reminders';

            let customers = [];
            let reminders = [];
            let currentTxCustomerId = null;
            let currentTxType = null;
            let editingCustomerId = null;
            let lastTx = null;

            // ===== UTILITY =====
            function fmt(n) {
                if (n === undefined || n === null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
                return Number(n).toLocaleString() + ' تومان';
            }

            function fmtShort(n) {
                if (n === undefined || n === null || isNaN(n)) return '—';
                return Number(n).toLocaleString();
            }

            function getNum(id) {
                const v = parseFloat(document.getElementById(id).value.replace(/,/g, ''));
                return isNaN(v) ? 0 : v;
            }

            function closeModal(id) {
                document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active');
            }

            function openModal(id) {
                document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
            }

            function launchStar() {
                const star = document.createElement('div');
                star.className = 'shooting-star';
                star.style.top = (Math.random() * 50 + 10) + '%';
                star.style.left = (Math.random() * 70 + 10) + '%';
                star.style.animationDuration = (1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8) + 's';
                document.body.appendChild(star);
                setTimeout(() => star.remove(), 1800);
            }

            // ===== TOAST =====
            const toastEl = document.getElementById('toast');
            const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toastMsg');
            const undoBtn = document.getElementById('undoBtn');
            let toastTimeout = null;

            function showToast(msg, isError = false, undoFn = null) {
                toastMsg.textContent = msg;
                toastEl.className = 'toast ' + (isError ? 'error' : '') + ' show';
                if (undoFn) {
                    undoBtn.style.display = 'block';
                    undoBtn.onclick = () => { undoFn();
                        toastEl.classList.remove('show'); };
                } else {
                    undoBtn.style.display = 'none';
                }
                if (toastTimeout) clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
                toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => toastEl.classList.remove('show'), 4500);
            }

            // ===== STARS =====
            const sc = document.getElementById('starsCanvas');
            const sctx = sc.getContext('2d');
            sc.width = window.innerWidth;
            sc.height = window.innerHeight;
            const stars = Array.from({ length: 220 }, () => ({
                x: Math.random() * sc.width,
                y: Math.random() * sc.height,
                r: Math.random() * 1.6 + 0.3,
                a: Math.random(),
                sp: Math.random() * 0.016 + 0.004
            }));

            function drawStars() {
                sctx.clearRect(0, 0, sc.width, sc.height);
                stars.forEach(s => {
                    s.a += s.sp;
                    if (s.a > 1 || s.a < 0.07) s.sp *= -1;
                    sctx.beginPath();
                    sctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    sctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.abs(s.a)})`;
                    sctx.fill();
                });
                requestAnimationFrame(drawStars);
            }
            drawStars();
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => { sc.width = window.innerWidth;
                sc.height = window.innerHeight; });

            // ===== DATA =====
            function save() {
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_CUSTOMERS, JSON.stringify(customers));
                localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_REMINDERS, JSON.stringify(reminders));
            }

            function load() {
                customers = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_CUSTOMERS) || '[]');
                reminders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_REMINDERS) || '[]');
                customers.forEach(c => {
                    c.balance = (c.transactions || []).reduce((a, t) => a + t.amount, 0);
                    if (!c.phone) c.phone = '';
                });
            }

            function recalcBalances() {
                customers.forEach(c => {
                    c.balance = (c.transactions || []).reduce((a, t) => a + t.amount, 0);
                });
            }

            // ===== RENDER =====
            function renderCustomers() {
                const search = (document.getElementById('searchInput').value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                const filter = document.getElementById('filterStatus').value || 'all';
                recalcBalances();

                let filtered = customers.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(search));
                if (filter === 'owed') filtered = filtered.filter(c => c.balance > 0);
                else if (filter === 'credit') filtered = filtered.filter(c => c.balance < 0);
                else if (filter === 'settled') filtered = filtered.filter(c => c.balance === 0);

                const list = document.getElementById('customerList');
                if (filtered.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">👥 مشتری‌ای یافت نشد.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = filtered.map(c => {
                    const bal = c.balance;
                    const cls = bal > 0 ? 'owed' : (bal < 0 ? 'credit' : 'settled');
                    const txt = bal > 0 ? '🔴 بدهکار ' + fmt(bal) :
                        (bal < 0 ? '🟢 طلبکار ' + fmt(Math.abs(bal)) : '⚪ تسویه');
                    const txCount = (c.transactions || []).length;
                    return `<div class="customer-card">
                        <div class="cust-info" data-id="${c.id}">
                            <div class="cust-name">${c.name} ${c.phone ? '<span class="cust-phone">📞 '+c.phone+'</span>' : ''} <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text2);">(${txCount} تراکنش)</span></div>
                            <div class="cust-balance balance ${cls}">${txt}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="actions">
                            <button class="act-btn plus" data-id="${c.id}" data-type="plus" title="افزایش بدهی (خرید)">+</button>
                            <button class="act-btn minus" data-id="${c.id}" data-type="minus" title="کاهش بدهی (پرداخت)">−</button>
                            <button class="act-btn del" data-id="${c.id}" data-action="edit" title="ویرایش">✎</button>
                            <button class="act-btn del" data-id="${c.id}" data-action="delete" title="حذف">✕</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');

                // Stats
                document.getElementById('totalCustomers').textContent = customers.length;
                document.getElementById('totalDebt').textContent = fmt(customers.reduce((a, c) => a + Math.max(0, c.balance),
                0));
                document.getElementById('totalCredit').textContent = fmt(customers.reduce((a, c) => a + Math.max(0, -c
                    .balance), 0));
                document.getElementById('totalTx').textContent = customers.reduce((a, c) => a + (c.transactions || [])
                    .length, 0);
            }

            function renderDashboard() {
                recalcBalances();
                const total = customers.length;
                const debt = customers.reduce((a, c) => a + Math.max(0, c.balance), 0);
                const credit = customers.reduce((a, c) => a + Math.max(0, -c.balance), 0);
                document.getElementById('dashCustomers').textContent = total;
                document.getElementById('dashDebt').textContent = fmt(debt);
                document.getElementById('dashCredit').textContent = fmt(credit);
                document.getElementById('dashAvg').textContent = total > 0 ? fmt(debt / total) : '—';

                // Status chart
                const owed = customers.filter(c => c.balance > 0).length;
                const cred = customers.filter(c => c.balance < 0).length;
                const settled = customers.filter(c => c.balance === 0).length;
                const maxVal = Math.max(owed, cred, settled, 1);
                const chart = document.getElementById('statusChart');
                chart.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="chart-bar-item"><div class="chart-bar red" style="height:${(owed/maxVal)*80}px;"></div><span class="chart-bar-label">بدهکار ${owed}</span></div>
                    <div class="chart-bar-item"><div class="chart-bar green" style="height:${(cred/maxVal)*80}px;"></div><span class="chart-bar-label">طلبکار ${cred}</span></div>
                    <div class="chart-bar-item"><div class="chart-bar gold" style="height:${(settled/maxVal)*80}px;"></div><span class="chart-bar-label">تسویه ${settled}</span></div>
                `;

                // Top debtors
                const sorted = [...customers].filter(c => c.balance > 0).sort((a, b) => b.balance - a.balance).slice(0, 5);
                const listEl = document.getElementById('topDebtorsList');
                if (sorted.length === 0) {
                    listEl.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;">هیچ بدهکاری یافت نشد.</p>';
                } else {
                    listEl.innerHTML = sorted.map(c =>
                        `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);"><span>${c.name}</span><span style="color:var(--danger);">${fmt(c.balance)}</span></div>`
                    ).join('');
                }
            }

            function renderAging() {
                recalcBalances();
                const now = Date.now();
                const body = document.getElementById('agingTableBody');
                const debtors = customers.filter(c => c.balance > 0);
                if (debtors.length === 0) {
                    body.innerHTML =
                        '<tr><td colspan="6" style="color:var(--text2);">هیچ بدهکاری وجود ندارد.</td></tr>';
                    return;
                }
                body.innerHTML = debtors.map(c => {
                    const txs = (c.transactions || []).slice().sort((a, b) => b.dateObj - a.dateObj);
                    const lastTx = txs[0];
                    let days = 999;
                    if (lastTx && lastTx.dateObj) {
                        days = Math.floor((now - lastTx.dateObj) / 86400000);
                    }
                    const getAge = (d) => {
                        if (d === 999) return '<span class="tag green">بدون تراکنش</span>';
                        if (d <= 30) return `<span class="tag green">${d} روز</span>`;
                        if (d <= 60) return `<span class="tag yellow">${d} روز</span>`;
                        if (d <= 90) return `<span class="tag orange">${d} روز</span>`;
                        return `<span class="tag red">${d} روز</span>`;
                    };
                    const age0 = days <= 30 ? fmt(c.balance) : '—';
                    const age1 = (days > 30 && days <= 60) ? fmt(c.balance) : '—';
                    const age2 = (days > 60 && days <= 90) ? fmt(c.balance) : '—';
                    const age3 = days > 90 ? fmt(c.balance) : '—';
                    const label = days === 999 ? '—' : getAge(days);
                    return `<tr>
                        <td><strong>${c.name}</strong></td>
                        <td>${fmt(c.balance)}</td>
                        <td>${age0}</td>
                        <td>${age1}</td>
                        <td>${age2}</td>
                        <td>${age3}</td>
                    </tr>`;
                }).join('');
            }

            function renderReminders() {
                const list = document.getElementById('reminderList');
                if (reminders.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;">هیچ یادآوری ثبت نشده است.</p>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = reminders.map((r, i) => {
                    const cust = customers.find(c => c.id === r.customerId);
                    return `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);margin:4px 0;border:1px solid var(--border);">
                        <span><strong>${cust ? cust.name : 'مشتری حذف‌شده'}</strong> — ${r.text}</span>
                        <button class="btn danger small" data-rid="${i}">🗑️</button>
                    </div>`;
                }).join('');
                // delete reminder
                list.querySelectorAll('[data-rid]').forEach(btn => {
                    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                        const idx = parseInt(this.dataset.rid);
                        reminders.splice(idx, 1);
                        save();
                        renderReminders();
                        showToast('یادآوری حذف شد.');
                    });
                });
            }

            function renderStatement(customerId) {
                const container = document.getElementById('statementResult');
                const cust = customers.find(c => c.id === customerId);
                if (!cust) {
                    container.innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--text2);text-align:center;">مشتری انتخاب نشده است.</p>';
                    return;
                }
                const txs = (cust.transactions || []).slice().reverse();

            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .stat-card.red .stat-number {
            color: #dc2626;
        }
        .stat-card.gold .stat-number {
            color: #d97706;
        }

        /* ---------- 8. SEARCH / FILTER ---------- */
        .search-filter-bar {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .search-box {
            flex: 3;
            min-width: 220px;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: 48px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 20px;
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: border var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
        }
        .search-box:focus-within {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.1);
        }
        .search-box input {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 12px 4px;
            border: none;
            background: transparent;
            outline: none;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: var(--text-main);
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .search-box input::placeholder {
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .filter-group {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .filter-group select,
        .filter-group input {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-main);
            transition: border var(--transition);
            cursor: pointer;
            outline: none;
            min-width: 140px;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .filter-group select:focus,
        .filter-group input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.1);
        }
        .filter-group option {
            background: var(--bg-card);
        }

        /* ---------- 9. RECORD CARDS ---------- */
        .data-grid {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .record-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 1.2rem 1.6rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all var(--transition);
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            position: relative;
        }
        .record-card::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: 4px;
            background: var(--primary);
            border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity var(--transition);
        }
        .record-card:hover::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .record-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary-light);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
            transform: translateX(6px) scale(1.005);
        }
        .record-card .tags-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }
        .record-card .tag {
            background: var(--border-color);
            padding: 0 10px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-main);
        }
        .record-info {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 220px;
        }
        .record-title {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .record-title .badge {
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            padding: 2px 16px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            font-weight: 700;
            display: inline-block;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
        }
        .badge-status {
            background: #e2e8f0;
            color: #475569;
        }
        .badge-status.waiting {
            background: #fef3c7;
            color: #b45309;
        }
        .badge-status.sent {
            background: #dbeafe;
            color: #1e40af;
        }
        .badge-status.interview {
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #166534;
        }
        .badge-status.accepted {
            background: #d1fae5;
            color: #065f46;
        }
        .badge-status.rejected {
            background: #fee2e2;
            color: #991b1b;
        }
        .badge-status.verified {
            background: #e0e7ff;
            color: #4338ca;
        }
        .record-meta {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-top: 6px;
        }
        .record-meta span {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        /* ---------- 10. PAGINATION ---------- */
        .pagination {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 2rem;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .page-btn {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 8px 20px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all var(--transition);
            color: var(--text-main);
            min-width: 44px;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .page-btn:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            color: var(--primary);
            transform: scale(1.05);
        }
        .page-btn.active {
            background: var(--primary);
            border-color: var(--primary);
            color: #fff;
        }
        .page-size-select {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            color: var(--text-main);
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }

        /* ---------- 11. MODAL (Glass) ---------- */
        .modal {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: var(--z-modal);
            visibility: hidden;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }
        .modal.active {
            visibility: visible;
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .modal-content {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            width: 96%;
            max-width: 680px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            padding: 2.4rem 2.6rem 2rem;
            box-shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            max-height: 92vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transform: scale(0.92) translateY(24px);
            transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
        }
        .modal.active .modal-content {
            transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
        }
        .modal-content h3 {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            margin-bottom: 1.6rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
        }
        .form-group label {
            display: block;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }
        .form-group input,
        .form-group select,
        .form-group textarea {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 14px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            background: var(--bg-light);
            color: var(--text-main);
            transition: border var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
            outline: none;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .form-group input:focus,
        .form-group select:focus,
        .form-group textarea:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.1);
        }
        .form-group textarea {
            resize: vertical;
            min-height: 100px;
        }
        .modal-buttons {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-top: 2rem;
        }

        /* ---------- 12. CHARTS ---------- */
        .chart-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 1.8rem;
            margin-top: 1.8rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            position: relative;
        }
        .chart-container h3 {
            margin-bottom: 1.6rem;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .chart-bars {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.8rem;
            align-items: flex-end;
            height: var(--chart-height);
            padding: 0 0.5rem;
            position: relative;
        }
        .chart-bar-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100%;
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .chart-bar {
            width: 80%;
            max-width: 56px;
            border-radius: var(--chart-bar-radius);
            transition: height 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            min-height: 4px;
            position: relative;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .chart-bar:hover {
            opacity: 0.9;
            transform: scaleX(1.1);
            filter: brightness(1.1);
        }
        .chart-bar .tooltip {
            position: absolute;
            top: -40px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            background: var(--text-main);
            color: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 4px 14px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.2s;
            pointer-events: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .chart-bar:hover .tooltip {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        .chart-label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            margin-top: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            max-width: 80px;
            word-break: break-word;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ---------- 13. TOAST ---------- */
        .toast-container {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 24px;
            right: 24px;
            z-index: var(--z-toast);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            max-width: 420px;
            width: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .toast {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            padding: 18px 24px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            animation: slideInRight 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            transform-origin: right;
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            pointer-events: auto;
            border-left: 6px solid var(--primary);
        }
        .toast.success {
            border-left-color: #16a34a;
        }
        .toast.error {
            border-left-color: #dc2626;
        }
        .toast.info {
            border-left-color: #3b82f6;
        }
        .toast .toast-icon {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
        }
        .toast .toast-msg {
            flex: 1;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .toast .toast-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0 4px;
            transition: color var(--transition);
        }
        .toast .toast-close:hover {
            color: var(--text-main);
        }
        @keyframes slideInRight {
            0% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateX(80px);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        /* ---------- 14. TOP LIST ---------- */
        .top-list {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 0;
        }
        .top-list li {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            margin: 6px 0;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all var(--transition);
        }
        .top-list li:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary-light);
            transform: translateX(6px);
        }
        .top-list .rank {
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--primary);
            margin-right: 12px;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }

        /* ---------- 15. NOTICE BOARD SECTION (NEW) ---------- */
        .notice-section {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 2rem 2.4rem;
            margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            position: relative;
        }
        .notice-section .notice-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }
        .notice-section .notice-header h3 {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .notice-section .notice-badge {
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 2px 18px;
            border-radius: 40px;
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .notice-section .notice-content {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 1.4rem;
        }
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .notice-section .notice-content {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }
        .notice-card {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            transition: all var(--transition);
        }
        .notice-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--primary-light);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }
        .notice-card .notice-card-title {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        .notice-card .notice-card-desc {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .notice-card .notice-card-result {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            background: var(--bg-card);
            padding: 10px 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--primary);
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        /* ---------- 16. X FEED ---------- */
        .x-feed {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 1.6rem 2rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        .x-feed .x-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
        }
        .x-feed .x-header .x-logo {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            background: #000;
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 900;
        }
        .x-item {
            padding: 14px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
            transition: background var(--transition);
        }
        .x-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        .x-item:hover {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
            padding-left: 8px;
            padding-right: 8px;
        }
        .x-item .x-avatar {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .x-item .x-body {
            flex: 1;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-user {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-handle {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-text {
            margin-top: 4px;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-meta {
            margin-top: 6px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            gap: 18px;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-meta span {
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: color var(--transition);
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .x-item .x-body .x-meta span:hover {
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        /* ---------- 17. TIMELINE ---------- */
        .timeline-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 16px;
            padding: 12px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-dot {
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--primary);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 4px;
            border: 2px solid var(--bg-card);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary);
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-content {
            flex: 1;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-title {
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .timeline-item .tl-meta {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
        }

        /* ---------- 18. RESPONSIVE ---------- */
        @media (max-width: 700px) {
            .record-card {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
            }
            .actions {
                justify-content: flex-end;
            }
            .header .brand h1 {
                font-size: 1.5rem;
            }
            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(110px, 1fr));
            }
            .modal-content {
                padding: 1.6rem;
            }
            .search-filter-bar {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: stretch;
            }
            .search-box {
                min-width: 0;
            }
            .filter-group {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }
            .filter-group select {
                flex: 1;
                min-width: 0;
            }
            .chart-bars {
                height: 160px;
            }
            .toast-container {
                left: 16px;
                right: 16px;
                max-width: unset;
            }
            .notice-section {
                padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
            }
            .header {
                position: static;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .header .brand h1 {
                font-size: 1.2rem;
            }
            .tab-btn {
                padding: 8px 16px;
                font-size: 0.8rem;
            }
            .stat-number {
                font-size: 1.6rem;
            }
            .btn {
                padding: 6px 14px;
                font-size: 0.8rem;
            }
        }

        /* ---------- 19. MISC ---------- */
        .highlight {
            background: #fbbf24;
            color: #0a0f1e;
            padding: 0 2px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        body.dark .highlight {
            background: #f59e0b;
        }
        .shimmer {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--bg-card) 25%, var(--border-color) 50%, var(--bg-card) 75%);
            background-size: 200% 100%;
            animation: shimmer 1.8s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% {
                background-position: 200% 0;
            }
            100% {
                background-position: -200% 0;
            }
        }
        .notification-dot {
            display: inline-block;
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            background: #ef4444;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse-dot 1.5s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {
                transform: scale(1.4);
            }
        }
        .glow-border {
            border: 1px solid var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
        }
        .text-gradient {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .avatar-lg {
            width: 60px;
            height: 60px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--secondary));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
        }
        .badge-live {
            background: #ef4444;
            color: #fff;
            padding: 2px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            animation: pulse-dot 1.5s infinite;
        }
        .badge-ultra {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 2px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* ---------- 20. RADAR CHART (placeholder) ---------- */
        .radar-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 1.4rem;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            margin-top: 1.4rem;
        }

        /* ---------- 21. SCROLL TO TOP ---------- */
        .scroll-top {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 30px;
            left: 30px;
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--primary);
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.3);
            transition: all var(--transition);
            z-index: 50;
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .scroll-top.visible {
            display: flex;
        }
        .scroll-top:hover {
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        /* ---------- 22. KEYBOARD HINT ---------- */
        .kbd {
            background: var(--bg-light);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 0 8px;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;

        // ================================================================

        // ---------- INDEXEDDB ----------
        const DB_NAME = "CareerProXDebugDB";
        const DB_VERSION = 13;
        let db = null;

        function openDB() {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
                req.onupgradeneeded = e => {
                    const dbRef = e.target.result;
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("companies")) {
                        const s = dbRef.createObjectStore("companies", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                        s.createIndex("status", "status", { unique: false });
                        s.createIndex("name", "name", { unique: false });
                        s.createIndex("favorite", "favorite", { unique: false });
                        s.createIndex("country", "country", { unique: false });
                    }
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("questions"))
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("questions", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("resources"))
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("resources", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("activity")) {
                        const s = dbRef.createObjectStore("activity", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                        s.createIndex("companyId", "companyId", { unique: false });
                        s.createIndex("timestamp", "timestamp", { unique: false });
                    }
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("network"))
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("network", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("notes")) {
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("notes", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                    }
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("reminders")) {
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("reminders", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                    }
                    if (!dbRef.objectStoreNames.contains("settings"))
                        dbRef.createObjectStore("settings", { keyPath: "id", autoIncrement: true });
                };
                req.onsuccess = e => { db = e.target.result;
                    resolve(); };
                req.onerror = e => reject(e.target.error);
            });
        }

        async function getAll(storeName) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readonly");
                tx.objectStore(storeName).getAll().onsuccess = e => resolve(e.target.result);
            });
        }

        async function addItem(storeName, item) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
                tx.objectStore(storeName).add(item).onsuccess = e => resolve(e.target.result);
            });
        }

        async function updateItem(storeName, item) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
                tx.objectStore(storeName).put(item).onsuccess = () => resolve();
            });
        }

        async function deleteItem(storeName, id) {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
                tx.objectStore(storeName).delete(id).onsuccess = () => resolve();
            });
        }

        async function bulkAdd(storeName, items) {
            const tx = db.transaction(storeName, "readwrite");
            const store = tx.objectStore(storeName);
            for (const item of items) store.add(item);
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
                tx.onerror = e => reject(e.target.error); });
        }

            div.innerHTML = `
                <span class="toast-icon">${icons[type] || "ℹ️"}</span>
                <span class="toast-msg">${message}</span>
                <button class="toast-close">✕</button>
            `;
            container.appendChild(div);
            div.querySelector(".t
